description: This file sets up and runs an asynchronous pipeline for a WebRTC-based conversational AI system, involving speech-to-text, language modeling, text-to-speech, and transport handling with event-driven callbacks.

classes.name: TavusTransport
classes.description: Transport class handling WebRTC communication with Tavus API, including event handlers for client connection and disconnection.

classes.name: Pipeline
classes.description: Defines the sequence of processing steps for the conversational pipeline.

classes.name: PipelineTask
classes.description: Encapsulates a pipeline with its parameters for execution.

classes.name: PipelineParams
classes.description: Configuration parameters for the pipeline execution.

classes.name: PipelineRunner
classes.description: Manages the execution of the pipeline.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main asynchronous function that initializes and runs the conversational pipeline.

methods.name: on_client_connected
methods.description: Event handler triggered when a client connects, starts the conversation.

methods.name: on_client_disconnected
methods.description: Event handler triggered when a client disconnects, cancels the pipeline task.
